# Delivery routes working session, 2026-02-18

Jory and the branch managers reworked the van loop six weeks into the [[Thistle Run|courier consolidation]]. Eastgate holds were arriving a day late because the second van reached the branch after it closed.

## Changes

- Van two now runs Eastgate first and Harlow Junction second.
- The afternoon pickup at Main Street moves from 3:30 to 2:45 so bins reach the sorting room the same day.
- Updated stop times go into the [[Van route timetable#Weekday loop]].

## Still open

Saturday runs. Branches would like one, but the drivers are part-time and the budget covers weekdays only; see [[Decision - End the Ridgeway hauling contract#Costs]].
